description: The mj-social-element network names the item dialog offers. A supported name carries MJML's own icon; any other choice is the custom network and then requires an explicit icon URL.

members.name: Supported
members.description: The names offered by the network select, in the order the dialog shows them.

members.name: IsSupported
members.description: Answers whether a name is a supported network (case-insensitive).
